policy.missing_outcome: Error in baseline API; fixture assembly explicitly excludes its one source row with missing outcome, recorded separately. No implicit target deletion.
policy.numeric: Observed values separately for each variable/outcome group; sample SD ddof1 and linear q25/q50/q75. No imputation or complete-case deletion across variables.
policy.categorical: Counts and proportions divide by observed nonmissing variable values within outcome class; missing counts shown separately.
policy.default_tests: Binary continuous two-sided MW auto; multiclass continuous tie-corrected KW. Categorical auto: 2x2 with any expected<5 uses two-sided Fisher, otherwise Pearson chi-square without Yates, including multiclass tables.
policy.degenerate: Empty observed group or constant categorical variable retains counts and explicit undefined statistic/p plus diagnostic; never removes the variable or fills zeros as feature values.
policy.unsupported: Explicit Fisher on a non-2x2 table errors; no global multiclass Fisher approximation.
